author: AI assistant (automated evidence + assistant visual review; not human-validated)

findings.evidence: Nearby green (small-class) rocks of 60-100 px are unboxed while 21-px distant blue rocks are boxed (frames 0676, 2875, 4044, 8894); 28,519 green components larger than the median CSV box in the candidate subset.
findings.impact: A detector trained on S1 must learn physical size from appearance; visible near obstacles become background.
findings.status: verified on full dataset (counts) + assistant visual review
findings.title: CSV 'large rock' is a renderer size class, not an apparent-size class

findings.evidence: 9/10 reviewed blue components >=1000 px without CSV box are merged groups; 16/86 additional candidates >=50 px merged; CSV unmatched boxes in 0742, 0977, 3933 caused by merges.
findings.impact: Mask-derived boxes cannot replace CSV instance boxes for large rocks; green boxes need a splitting step.
findings.title: Semantic mask merges touching rocks of the same class

findings.evidence: Green 25-50 px: 5/16 visible; 8 ambiguous, 3 not visible.
findings.title: Small mask components are often not visible rocks

findings.evidence: CSV boxes over black regions in non-listed frames 4191, 5409, 7220, 6133; S2 dark filter rejects most but not all.
findings.impact: Unlearnable targets; affects both S1 and S2.
findings.title: Labels on rocks hidden in black shadow outside the shadow list

findings.evidence: 3,034 cover part of a larger merged mask component; clean-strata review: 16/28 valid, 2 errors, 10 undetermined; anomaly strata: errors/mismatch.
findings.impact: Do not drop them wholesale; excluding anomaly frames removes most real errors.
findings.title: 3,177 'uncertain' CSV boxes are mostly a matching artefact, not label errors

findings.evidence: V2 match 0.801 vs V0 0.837; merged components 1,898 vs 1,705.
findings.title: Morphological closing worsens S2

findings.evidence: 18 images: 8 apparently rock-free, 2 rock-like/ambiguous (PosC sunlit), 8 unusable; PosB dominated by lamp tripod.
findings.impact: Exclude from quantitative false-positive rate; use qualitatively only.
findings.title: Terrain06 is not a verified negative set

findings.evidence: Fixed >>4 view: 5% of rock boxes visible at 16 ms, 26% at 32 ms, >92% at 128-1024 ms; enhanced view recovers dark frames; 1024-2048 ms clips sunlit rocks.
findings.impact: Evaluation must fix exposure selection and conversion; dark frames are not fair false negatives with fixed conversion.
findings.status: automated proxy + assistant review of 2 brackets
findings.title: NASA label visibility depends on exposure and 12->8-bit conversion

findings.impact: Must convert to RGB before colour tests (done in this pipeline).
findings.title: 48 ground masks are palette-mode PNGs
